verdict.rationale: The official start-parameters docs give a one-line conversion command (`--convert-to pdf:writer_pdf_Export --outdir ... *.doc`) and a headless mode for running without a UI. A documented filter list covers docx, xlsx, pptx, epub, svg, parquet and more. A community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize formats, which matches the scripted/CI use case. Missing for 10: documented exit-code and error-handling behavior for scripts, and CI-specific guidance such as running parallel instances.
